title: psydrax odoratus
intro: Psydrax odoratus, commonly known as the African sand olive or stink bush, is a plant species that belongs to the Rubiaceae family and is native to tropical Africa. The health benefits of Psydrax odoratus include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce fever, relieve respiratory issues, and act as a natural insect repellent, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Psydrax odoratus include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
